name: Alexandrie
description: Alexandrie is a self-hosted knowledge base and note-taking app built around an extended Markdown editor with LaTeX, diagrams and custom containers. Notes are organized in workspaces, categories and nested documents, can be shared with other users and stay available offline as an installable PWA.

notes.text: Create your account on the signup page. Signup stays open to anyone who can reach Alexandrie until you set CONFIG_DISABLE_SIGNUP and NUXT_PUBLIC_CONFIG_DISABLE_SIGNUP_PAGE to true in the .env.
The URLs in /opt/alexandrie_data/.env use the container IP. Change them when the IP changes or you put Alexandrie behind a domain, then restart alexandrie-backend and alexandrie-frontend.
